en: Colorized vintage postcard showing a rural scene titled in Spanish. It depicts a simple adobe or stone ranch house with a thatched or earthen roof, surrounded by a low stone wall. Several people stand near the building and a few cattle are visible. Large leafy trees and a dirt road frame the foreground, with a softly tinted sky in the background. The title text is printed at the top of the image.
